verdict.rationale: Superhuman's what's-new page says users can build agents that "run proactively based on triggers you set," which is close to recurring, user-defined workflows. It does not explicitly document time-based or recurring schedules, and the page also covers other Superhuman products, so Mail-specific scope is unclear. Other always-on features (Auto Labels, Auto Archive) and Smart Send timing are event-driven or one-off actions, not scheduled recurring jobs. missing for 10: explicit recurring or cron-style schedule configuration, confirmation that trigger-based agents apply to Superhuman Mail, documentation of trigger types and run history, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.
